note: Little Blue NRD's Bruning Dam & Wildlife Management Area: a 250-acre reservoir with 123 acres of public land, 2 mi E, 1 mi N and 1 mi E of Bruning. Camping is allowed only in the designated primitive camping area the NRD map marks beside the boat ramp at the south end, by the dam, reached by gravel road; no pads or hookups, and no fee is listed on the NRD's camper fee schedule. Restroom; boats 5 mph, trolling motors only; hunting area in season. --Claude

flags: CRITERIA / INCLUSION (possible drop): the entry was built on Lone Star's description. Little Blue NRD's Bruning Dam section lists 'Fishing, waterfowl and upland game hunting, archery for deer and turkey, horseback riding, trapping, boating (motors less than 5 HP), picnicking, restroom and boat ramp' and calls it 'a rustic area'; the 'Nineteen electrical ($20 per night fee effective May 1, 2021) RV Camper pads, ... floating dock, fishing pier ..., swimming beach' text is under Lone Star (4 mi E of Ohiowa), which already has its own entry (2815). Camping at Bruning: SSR 02.01A 'Camping, picnicking, and hiking are permitted in the designated areas, as per the attached map'; the map shows a single 'Primitive Camping' symbol just SW of the boat ramp. Imagery shows there only a gravel turnaround/parking loop (~40 m across, ~40.3526,-97.5051) at the end of the gravel access road by the ramp and the dam; no pads, tables or loop. It is NRD-designated primitive camping, so it is not dispersed, but what a camper gets is a spot by the ramp lot. A 23-ft rig can reach it on gravel. AWH's call whether a designated primitive area at a ramp lot is enough; the old inclusion_evidence already said the electric-pad claim was unverified.
SITES: count 19 (derived) cleared - it was Lone Star's figure. NRD general rule 01.05K caps camper units at 40 ft long / 102 in wide (written as max_rig_ft 40).

FEES: none written. The NRD's 2021 fee schedule ('No Annual Park Permits are Required') lists hookup fees only at Buckley Creek ($15), Liberty Cove and Lone Star ($20); it is silent on primitive camping at Bruning, so I did not record a $0.

WEBSITE: drop the second line https://www.nrdnet.org/rec-area/bruning-dam (HTTP 404 on 2026-11-05); keep https://littlebluenrd.org/recreation/ (its '#Bruning_Dam' anchor is the section). apply.py does not write website - by hand.
PHONE 402-364-2145 matches the Little Blue NRD office (Davenport) on the NRD page.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the camping area is the gravel turnaround by the ramp, ~35-50 m from the water with the ramp road and a brushy, treed bank between; no site can be tied to the shore. Stored pin 40.35330,-97.50420 is in brush ~110 m NE of the turnaround (under 250 m, no move needed).
SAND RULE: not applicable (gravel road and gravel lot).

LEADS (missing Little Blue NRD campgrounds, not in the DB by name): Liberty Cove Recreation Area ('Eight RV camper pads with electrical hookups ($20 per night fee)', 37-acre spring-fed lake, 2 mi W, 2 mi S and 1/4 W of Lawrence); Prairie Lake Recreation Area ('20 RV camper pads with electrical hookups ($20 per night fee; effective April 1, 2022)', 3 mi S and 1/4 mi E of Juniata); Buckley Creek Recreation Area ('6 camper hookups ($15 per night fee)' / 'four electrical camper pads', 1 mi E and 1/2 mi N of Reynolds). Source https://littlebluenrd.org/recreation/.
